headline: Ecolab Declares Cash Dividend
summary: ST. PAUL, Minn., August 06, 2026--The board of directors of Ecolab Inc. today declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.73 per common share, to be paid October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 15, 2026.
